name: shipcraft
description: Agent skills that carry engineering work from a foggy idea to shipped code.

plugins.name: shipcraft
plugins.description: Ten skills and three agents for AI-assisted engineering: map large work, slice it into shippable phases, pick the right data structures, deepen the architecture, draw the design as reviewed Excalidraw diagrams, run a feature end to end through an agent pipeline with a live run board, watch a team of agents in a live project control room, and ship pull requests with reviewed screenshots. The agents implement, review and test Frappe changes.
